The first deploy failed with 'No Output Directory named build found after
the Build completed'. The build itself had already succeeded — Vite wrote
dist/ exactly as it always does — and Vercel then went looking in build/,
which is Create React App's directory and has never been this project's.
The project settings were answering a question this repo is the authority
on, so the repo answers it: framework, command and output directory are
all stated, and vercel.json takes precedence over the dashboard.
outputDirectory is 'dist' because that is Vite's default and vite.config
does not override it. If it ever does, these two move together.

React has booted. Without this, every route but / returns a 404 from the
static host and the split ships broken for anyone who does not enter
